theme: Team Round Domain and Scoring Contract

shots.title: Define the Team Round lifecycle and finalization model

hazards.description: [architect review] Round uniqueness and idempotency lacked a stable project namespace
[architect review] Reopen semantics did not identify which scorecard version remained authoritative
[architect review] Reopen correction_scope was recorded but not enforced on mutations or the final delta

shots.notes: Defined project-scoped round and attempt identity, immutable scorecard versions, exact finalization, audited reopen, late-evidence handling, and correction-scope enforcement.

shots.title: Define principals, actors, sessions, roles, authority, and visibility
shots.notes: Separated durable principals and actors from sessions and roles, with explicit authority, visibility allowlists, retirement, and anti-history-reset constraints.

shots.title: Define Team Round scoring estimands and uncertainty

hazards.description: [architect review] Handoff abandonment and unresolved ownership spells could be interpreted as observed zero loss
[architect review] Canonical penalty identity was scheduled after the schema needed for finalization
[ml-engineer review] Completed-shot selection conflicted with an estimand whose denominator includes every accepted exposure
[ml-engineer review] Post-outcome handoff state could leak the response into difficulty adjustment
[ml-engineer review] Shot loss and penalty loss could count the same failure twice
[ml-engineer review] Estimator weights and clustered uncertainty were underspecified
[ml-engineer review] Unattributed penalties could bias an actor or role handicap downward
[ml-engineer review] The expected-loss model could learn the evaluated identity or response
[ml-engineer review] Five rounds were insufficient for ordinary cluster-bootstrap inference
[ml-engineer review] External predictive uncertainty could double-count aleatoric outcome variance

shots.notes: Defined ownership-spell estimands over accepted exposures, a disjoint loss ledger, missingness rules, identity-safe adjustment, and round-cluster inference thresholds.

shots.title: Define compatibility and shared-resource boundaries

hazards.description: [architect review] Shared-resource identity mixed the protected subject with access mode and policy
[architect review] Legacy import did not deterministically reconstruct lifecycle or identity
[architect review] The minimum canonical scorecard schema was scheduled after the finalization implementation that depends on it
[ml-engineer review] Legacy agents role labels could not safely establish actor identity

shots.notes: Defined typed resource subjects, cross-mode conflict fencing, deterministic legacy import, and schema ownership across S268 and S270.

conditions.description: The contract governs multi-agent identity, shared-resource authority, finalization, and statistical attribution across later implementation sprints.

training.description: A multiplayer scoring contract must separate lifecycle truth, identity truth, and statistical estimands before implementation begins.
training.outcome: The roadmap now assigns the minimum canonical schema before finalization and keeps attribution models downstream of accepted evidence.

nutrition.description: 259 test files passed; 4,324 tests passed and 27 were skipped.
TypeScript typecheck and the root plus pi-extension production build passed on Node 22.
The primary sprint-state SHA-256 remained unchanged across the complete test suite.

bunker_locations: Namespace every Team Round identity and idempotency key by stable project identity.
Keep resource subject identity independent from access mode and policy so cross-mode overlap cannot bypass coordination.
Do not treat incomplete, handed-off, retried, or unresolved ownership spells as observed zero loss.
Train difficulty adjustment outside the evaluated identity and round response.
yardage_book_updates: Pin accepted scorecard and as-of versions before computing any Team Round estimate.
Keep shot loss, penalty loss, and round adjustments disjoint.
Require correction_scope enforcement on every reopened mutation and on the final delta.
Assign the minimum canonical scorecard and penalty identity schema to S268 before finalization.
course_management_notes: S264.1 should turn this domain contract into the coordination and security contract without reopening the settled scoring estimand.
